claims.text: Where Women Are Most Likely to Hire Employees
claims.support: Global comparison of the share of working women who are employers based on World Bank indicator SL.EMP.MPYR.FE.ZS.
Topic indicator theme: Employers, female (% of female employment).

claims.text: Share of working women who are employers across the world, based on World Bank data.
claims.support: Share of working women who are employers across the world, based on World Bank data.

claims.text: In East Timor, 15.6% of working women hire employees. In the USA, it is 1.2%.
That gives East Timor 13 times what the USA has.
claims.support: TLS 15.6% divided by USA 1.2% is approximately 13.

claims.text: At the world's lowest end, Pakistan has just 0.1%.
Djibouti sits near the top with 14.6%, while Azerbaijan has 13.1%.
Big economies lag behind: China has 2.7%, Germany 2%, the UK 0.9%, and India 0.6%.
Nigeria stands out in Africa, where 10.4% of working women hire staff.
How many working women hire employees in your country?
